title: Charles Ham's "And She": A Fresh Blend of Trap and R&B
htmlContent:
Charlotte-based artist Charles Ham has recently released his first single, "And She," which offers a unique blend of Trap and R&B. The track features a back-and-forth performance by Charles and Xhozen, a fellow up-and-coming MC from Charlotte. This collaboration creates an unforgettable sonic experience that you won't find anywhere else.

"And She" sets the tone for what's to come with its memorable punchlines, undeniable flows, and fresh sound. The song is the first single of Charles' upcoming EP, set to be released in April. The EP promises to showcase Charles' talents as a songwriter, producer, and recording artist.

Charles has been honing his craft for years, opening for Deniro Farrar and performing at Nopi Nationals Car Show in his early days. He has also been a model and creative director, landing appearances with big names such as Adidas, A Ma Maniere, and Highsnobietystyle.

With his versatile sound and undeniable talent, Charles is a rising star to watch out for. "And She" is just the beginning of what promises to be an exciting journey for this Charlotte-based artist.
